website/components/dialogs/preferences/webgl.ts
Sourcesrc/website/components/dialogs/preferences/webgl.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

commitSwitch

Commits the pref mutation matching a switch type.

switchActive

Current toggle state for a switch type.

mountThemeSlider

Mounts the theme slider on its live canvas (rebuilding on canvas swap).

mountSwitches

Mounts one SwitchWebGL per data-switch canvas.

mountCloseButton

Mounts the header close button on its live canvas.

mountDoneBrackets

Mounts the corner-brackets WebGPU widget on the done button. The overlay canvas is a button child — re-renders remove it with the button, so a stored teardown whose button left the DOM is dropped and a fresh mount attempted (mountCornerBrackets no-ops without WebGPU).

mountWebGLControls

Mounts all WebGL widgets onto the freshly rendered canvases.

destroyWebGLControls

Tears down the mounted GL widgets.
